name: Multifamily Deep Research Engine - Main Workflow

httpHeaderAuth.name: PDF Noodle API Header Auth account

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "success",
  "deal_name": "{{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.deal_name }}",
  "address": "{{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.address }}",
  "analysis_summary": {
    "total_criteria": 30,
    "green_count": {{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.green_count }},
    "yellow_count": {{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.yellow_count }},
    "red_count": {{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.red_count }},
    "recommendation": "{{ $('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.recommendation }}"
  },
  "heat_map": {{ JSON.stringify($('Build Heat Map HTML').first().json.heat_map) }},
  "pdf_url": "{{ $('Generate PDF (PDF Noodle)').first().json.signedUrl }}",
  "generated_at": "{{ $now.toISO() }}"
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "request": {
    "model": "sonar-deep-research",
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "system",
        "content": "You are an expert real estate market research analyst. Return comprehensive structured data with citations."
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Conduct comprehensive deep research for multifamily investment at: {{ $('Extract Input Data').first().json.address }}

RESEARCH ALL DATA POINTS:

=== MSA-LEVEL (16 criteria) ===
1. MSA Population (current total)
2. Population Growth Rate (annual % last 3-5 years)
3. Employment Growth (annual job growth %)
4. Income Growth (median household income growth %)
5. Net Migration (in vs out migration numbers)
6. Job Diversity (top industries by %, any >25%?)
7. Environmental Risk (FEMA flood zone, wildfire, hurricane)
8. Unemployment Rate (current %)
9. Apartment Vacancy Rate (current MF vacancy %)
10. Cap Rate Spread (MF cap rates vs 10yr Treasury)
11. Homeowner Vacancy Rate (for-sale vacancy %)
12. Multifamily Permits (new permits as % of stock)
13. Absorption Rate (months to absorb pipeline)
14. Landlord Laws (rent control?, eviction timeline)
15. Affordability (median rent as % of income)
16. Tier 1 MSA proximity (distance to major metro)

=== SUBMARKET-LEVEL (14 criteria) ===
17. Crime Rate (vs MSA average)
18. School Ratings (GreatSchools nearby)
19. Retail Amenities (miles to grocery/retail)
20. School Proximity (miles to good schools)
21. Transit Access (miles to transit)
22. Highway/Airport Distance (noise concerns)
23. Path of Growth (development corridor?)
24. Zoning (MF allowed?)
25. Renter Density (% renters in area)
26. Nearby MF Comps (properties within 1mi)
27. Development Potential (available land)
28. Property Tax Rate (% of value)
29. Historical Appreciation (5-10yr %)
30. Government Stability (fiscal health)

Return comprehensive JSON with all data points. Provide ACTUAL VALUES from authoritative sources."
      }
    ],
    "temperature": 0.1,
    "return_citations": true
  }
}
